summary:
Iteration 100 — Manager PIN-gate hardening verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter100_manager_pin_gate.py PASS on live preview: (1) section-access as manager w/ no pin returns {ok:false, pin_required:true}; (2) with wrong pin '9999' returns 403; (3) with correct pin 4321 returns {ok:true}; (4) require_owner_pin on /api/manager/activity-logs w/o X-Owner-Pin => 403 OWNER_PIN_REQUIRED, with X-Owner-Pin: 4321 => 200 (both manager and admin); (5) temporarily unset security_pin_hash on tenant (RESTORED afterwards, pin_attempts cleared) — manager hitting activity-logs got 403 OWNER_PIN_NOT_SET (no silent access), section-access returned {ok:false, no_pin_set:true, pin_required:true}, admin still got {ok:true}. Frontend: manager@miracurl.com login → /attendance renders full-screen [data-testid=manager-lock-screen] popup with heading exactly 'Sorry, you're not authorized', body 'Attendance is locked by the salon owner and needs the Admin PIN. This visit has been logged.', [data-testid=manager-enter-pin-btn] and [data-testid=manager-pin-cancel-btn] visible. Attendance page content (roster / check-in table) is NOT rendered behind the popup —
only contains the lock component (verified by asserting body innerText contains no 'check-in|roster|late fine' regex hits). Enter PIN reveals [data-testid=manager-pin-input] + [data-testid=manager-pin-unlock-btn]. Entering '12' → toast 'PIN must be 4–8 digits' shown, stays on lock screen. Entering 9999 → routed back to /dashboard after ~1s. Cancel from /attendance (with /dashboard as history) → routed to /dashboard. Entering 4321 → attendance page fully loads, 'Attendance unlocked ✦' success toast visible, staff roster + GPS fence card rendered. Admin regression: admin@miracurl.com → /settings shows [data-testid=admin-lock-screen], PIN 4321 unlocks, /dashboard loads fine, GET /api/whats-new returns build 2026-08-08.65 as expected. No lockout was triggered (only 1 wrong PIN per scenario, pin_attempts collection cleared in backend test teardown).
critical_code_review_comments: ManagerLockScreen.jsx: the initial useEffect POSTs section-access without a pin to log the visit — good audit trail. onUnlocked() is only called if backend explicitly returns ok:true, so no silent auto-unlock is possible even if the promise resolves with unexpected shape.

AppLayout.jsx L114 isLockedNow gate uses sessionStorage key 'mgr_unlock:{userId}:{path}' — this is intentionally per-tab and cleared on browser close; also applied to admins via ADMIN_LOCKED, which is why /settings + /staff still ask the owner for the PIN on shared devices. Good.

security.py require_owner_pin L315-316: for manager role on a tenant with NO pin set, it now raises 403 OWNER_PIN_NOT_SET (was previously a fail-open return True). This closes the silent-access leak reported by the user. Verified with a mongo-toggle test — behavior is correct.

manager_access.py section_access L48-53: same fix on the manager path — returns pin_required:true, no_pin_set:true instead of ok:true when tenant has no hash. Admin path still returns ok:true (owner without a PIN still gets in, as expected).

Consider adding rate-limit for section-access wrong-PIN attempts (right now _pin_attempt_guard IS called at L57 in manager_access.py, so 5 wrong attempts across sections still lock the tenant for 15 min — this is correct, ignore).

MINOR (pre-existing, not part of this iteration): repeated console error 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning across all pages — some Select rendering a span inside an <option>. Worth fixing during a UI cleanup pass.
test_credentials: manager@miracurl.com / Manager@1234; admin@miracurl.com / q6QY@tn3p#9DtL; tenant slug miracurl-marathahalli; Owner PIN 4321.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test temporarily unset security_pin_hash on tenant miracurl-marathahalli, verified no-pin behavior for managers, then restored the original hash and cleared pin_attempts within the same test — verified by running the test twice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All manager PIN-gate testids working: manager-lock-screen, manager-enter-pin-btn, manager-pin-cancel-btn, manager-pin-input, manager-pin-unlock-btn, manager-no-pin-note (only visible when tenant has no pin set). Admin lock uses admin-lock-screen + admin-pin-input + admin-pin-unlock-btn. Unlock state persists per tab under sessionStorage key mgr_unlock:{userId}:{path}. Wrong-PIN toast appears briefly (~800ms then routes back) — capture toast within 1500ms of click if you need to assert it. Pytest module runs cleanly in 3-4s; safe to include in regression runs.
rca of the issue: Root cause of the original bug (managers auto-opening PIN-locked sections when no PIN was set): require_owner_pin in security.py used to `return True` when tenant.security_pin_hash was missing, treating 'no PIN configured' as 'PIN not required for anyone'. Fix (already applied): explicit role check — if role==manager and no pin_hash → raise 403 OWNER_PIN_NOT_SET; admins still pass (they are the tenant owner). Mirror change applied in manager_access.section_access — returns {ok:false, pin_required:true, no_pin_set:true} to managers instead of ok:true. ManagerLockScreen.jsx surfaces this to the user with a 'Sorry, you're not authorized' popup (Enter PIN / Cancel), and the noPinSet branch shows an amber note prompting the owner to set a PIN in Settings. All verified live.
